tooltip.sculkhorde.blade_of_purity.funct: §7§oA weapon that upon striking a Sculk Horde mob, will give it the purity effect and purify the surrounding land.
tooltip.sculkhorde.blade_of_purity.lore: §7§oA weapon imbued with the warm and embracing aura of purity. Holding it fills your body with the resolve to restore balance to a corrupted world. All anguished souls will know peace once they meet this weapon.
info.thermal.hazmat_armor: Protects from various hazards. Wearing the full set provides infinite Purity.
